thread:
Maria Lopez: Heads up — LinguaAI pilot asked for Optimize toolkit support for multilingual long-context traffic. They want per-language quantization recommendations, runtime fallback to higher precision for sensitive langs, and eval-triggered alerts scoped by language + prompt set. Also asked for a pilot launch checklist by EOW.
Jon Patel: Do we have per-language quality telemetry after quant?
Devon Reed: Not at that granularity. We can run targeted evals if they share a prompt sample and metrics. I can own the runs.
Sara Nguyen: Important: some languages (e.g., vi, ar, bn) show bigger regressions on 4-bit. They need automatic routing to fp16 for those slices when confidence is low.
Maria Lopez: Suggested pilot scope: 1) ingest & sanitize customer prompt corpus, 2) run per-language baselines vs quant profiles, 3) produce recommended quant profiles + confidence thresholds, 4) add routing policy extension (language predicate + precision override), 5) wire eval-triggered soft alerts to slack, and PD escalation rules.
Jon Patel: Routing policy DSL extension sketch: ```policies:\n- name: lang-quant-fallback\n  match: "language =~ /vi|ar|bn/"\n  condition: "model.quant.confidence < 0.85"\n  action: "route_variant: fp16"\n```
Devon Reed: Note: adding language detection per-request has CPU cost and must run early for long-context requests. We'll measure p99 latency impact and include it in acceptance.
Sara Nguyen: Ops reqs: include a manual kill-switch; canary rollout (1% -> 10% -> 100%); rollback when per-lang quality or latency breaches thresholds. I'll write the runbook.
Maria Lopez: Draft acceptance criteria: per-lang quality delta <= 1.5% (customer metric), p99 latency increase <= +30ms, routing CPU overhead < 5%. Also require unit tests for policy DSL extension and perf benchmarks.
Jon Patel: For alerts: start with soft alerts (email + #support ping), escalate to PD only if X regressions in 24h. Less noise for pilot.
Sara Nguyen: Agreed. Add configurable noise threshold and an alert-suppression window to the runbook.
Devon Reed: I'll need ground-truth scoring or a scoring function from LinguaAI. Can they provide expected outputs or an oracle metric?
Maria Lopez: I'll ask them for a 2k prompt sample and their preferred metric. I'll also propose weekly sync during the pilot.
prod-bot: Created tasks: #9876 eval runs (Devon), #9877 policy-dsl (Jon), #9878 runbook + canary (Sara), #9879 customer sign-off (Maria). ETA: initial eval artifacts by EOW. :white_check_mark:
Jon Patel: One more: include a dashboard tile per-language showing quality delta, quant-profile in use, and routing fraction so customer and ops can quickly see which langs are failing.
Sara Nguyen: I'll mock a dashboard in the runbook; Ops can hook it up to Console.
Maria Lopez: Thanks team — I'll follow up with the customer and confirm metric. If they share prompts today, Devon will start runs. Meeting if needed.
